designationHistory.indexText: Established in November 1978 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act as an inviolate sanctuary for migratory birds and to conserve wetlands of the Ouachita River.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

Louisiana LandCAN: Upper Ouachita NWR established in November 1978 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act

designationHistory.indexOriginal: It was established in November of 1978 “for use as an inviolate sanctuary, or for any other management purpose, for migratory birds” (Migratory Bird Conservation Act, 16 U.S.C. 715d); and for “…the conservation of the wetlands of the nation in order to maintain the public benefits they provide and to help fulfill international obligations contained in various migratory bird treaties and convention
